Title: More questions about merging and anarch converts

Messages.Author: Janne Hägglund
Messages.Body:
1) I control *basic* Kamiri wa Itherero, who has been converted to Anarch by
an Anarch Convert. I now merge him. What happens to his anarch status?
(My guess: the card text in the advanced version makes him a Laibon again.)

2) I control *advanced* Kamiri wa Itherero, Anarch Converted as above.
I have a basic version of him in my crypt, and I merge him. He should remain
Anarch, correct?

Thanks in advance,
HG
